descriptions.w3d_init_fade_800fddd8: Initializes a fade record: clears and resets its fields, converts the start and end bytes to floats (quantized load), sets the active flag and the duration if positive.
descriptions.w3d_set_voice_pan_801e58b0: Offsets and scales the value, converts it to a byte (quantized store) and sends it as sound control 10 for the held voice.
descriptions.w3d_set_voice_pan_801e5908: Offsets and scales the value, converts it to a byte (quantized store) and sends it as sound control 10 for the held voice.
descriptions.w3d_set_voice_pitch_801e5960: Scales the value, converts it to a signed 16-bit control (quantized store), offsets it by 8192 and sends it as sound control 132 for the held voice.
descriptions.w3d_update_tint_8026b2c4: If enabled and a target exists, copies the current colour, sets its alpha from a float field (quantized store) and applies it to the target.
descriptions.w3d_update_tint_802a0d44: If enabled and a target exists, copies the current colour, sets its alpha from a float field (quantized store) and applies it to the target.
